phrase.zh: 微小的纸页，也容得下辽阔。
phrase.en: A small page can hold a wide world.

visual.zh: 狄金森的生成肖像与信封、纸页和细线组成私密而开放的空间。纸张暗示手稿和通信，但不是她真实字迹的摹本。
visual.en: A generated Dickinson portrait, envelopes, pages and fine lines create a private yet expansive space. Paper evokes manuscripts and letters without reproducing her handwriting.

background.zh: 狄金森博物馆区分诗歌作品与其物质手稿：约 2,500 份诗稿并不等于 2,500 首不同的诗，同一诗作可能有改写或异本。观察这些纸面差异，能看见一位诗人如何持续试探词语，而不是只有一个固定的“最终答案”。
background.en: The Dickinson Museum distinguishes poems from surviving manuscripts: about 2,500 poem manuscripts do not mean 2,500 distinct poems. Versions may differ. Their material variations reveal a writer testing language, rather than only a single fixed final text.
